snippet.title: Desperate Green Farmers - iPhone, iPad and Facebook game by Gameloft
snippet.description:
Play now on iPhone / iPad: http://glft.co/jROUAP 
Or on Facebook: http://www.facebook.com/greenfarm
Discover Gameloft's online social game you can play wherever you are, on both Facebook and your iPhone or iPad!  With its fresh design and huge variety, Green Farm takes farming apps to the next level.

Official site: http://www.gameloft.com

Friend us on Facebook: http://www.facebook.com/Gameloft

Follow us on Twitter: http://twitter.com/Gameloft

Visit our blog: http://blog.gameloft.com
